submittedForReview: Submitted; it takes effect after a second platform administrator approves it

deleteEnforcedBody: “{{name}}” is enforced; deleting it needs a second platform administrator to approve.

pii.title: Platform PII rules
pii.subtitle: PII baseline rules every tenant inherits; tenant changes never alter platform rules.

field.name: Rule name
field.blockMessagePlaceholder: Shown to the user when blocked; leave empty for the default message.
field.enforcedHint: Tenants and assistants cannot switch an enforced rule off (they may edit its content). Adding, switching off or retiring one needs a second platform administrator.

patternHint.regex: Must be a valid regular expression.
patternHint.keyword: Separate keywords with commas or new lines.

changes.title: Enforced-rule changes awaiting review
changes.hint: The reviewer cannot be the requester · expires after 72 hours

baseline.title: Security baseline
baseline.subtitle: Platform rules distributed to tenants by plan, region and industry; drafts are not distributed.

levelHint.enforced: Tenants and assistants cannot disable or relax it.
levelHint.recommended: On by default; tenants may switch it off.

statusHint: Drafts are not distributed to any tenant.
rulesetHint: PII baseline rows only reference rules from the Platform PII rules page; they store no pattern of their own.
retentionHint: An enforced rule caps the retention a tenant can choose; a recommended rule sets the default.

inheritedNotice.tenant: This rule is inherited from the platform. Saving makes it a tenant rule; the platform rule does not change.
inheritedNotice.assistant: This rule is inherited. Saving makes it an assistant rule; the upper rule does not change.

tenant.title: Tenant PII rules
tenant.subtitle: Maintain this tenant's PII rules on top of the platform baseline; they apply to every assistant that references the global rules.
tenant.inheritHint: Enforced platform rules always apply; every rule can be edited and becomes a tenant rule when edited. When off, only enforced platform rules remain.
tenant.priority: Priority: assistant > tenant > platform; a lock marks an enforced platform rule that cannot be switched off.
tenant.submittedForApproval: Submitted for approval; it takes effect once approved.
tenant.approvalHint: Rule changes need approval in this tenant: they take effect only after approval.

toast.savedAsTenant: Saved as a tenant rule; the platform rule is unchanged

assistant.detectionHint: When off, every rule that is not enforced is disabled; enforced platform rules always apply.
assistant.useGlobalHint: Inherit the tenant rule library; when off only enforced platform rules and the assistant's own rules remain. Not available while detection is off.
